name: Continents
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly shaped the continents by gathering the waters to reveal dry land, which He named Earth, affirming His intentional design and goodness in creation. The earth is described as being suspended upon nothing, demonstrating God's power in sustaining it. Boundaries for the waters and the stability of the land are established by God's command, highlighting His control over the natural order. The references to mountains and rocks being firmly set further emphasize the strength and permanence of the continents as part of God's creative work.
